title: Founding of Jamestown
description:
**Jamestown**, the first permanent English settlement in North America, was established on May 14, 1607, in present-day Virginia.

The colony struggled initially with disease, starvation, and conflict with Native Americans. John Smith's leadership and Pocahontas's intervention helped the colony survive.

Jamestown became the capital of the Virginia Colony and the birthplace of representative government in America.
